'''Ben Clark''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[May 2000 Salt Lake City tournament]] on 3 May 2000 with Big Blue Space with Coruscant start, according to Matthew Jensen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d667">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200d667/ salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 4 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-04-salt-lake-city-utah-5-3-200d667/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
